# YM7128B emulator

An emulator of the Yamaha YM7128B surround processor, by Andrea Zoppi. The
AdLib Gold's surround module is built on this chip; Mentat uses it for the
AdLib Gold music. It is not game code.

- Upstream: https://github.com/TexZK/YM7128B_emu
- Version: 0.1.3, commit `3a8c079e49e90487aba9a8ff887aac9ff38a7083`
- License: BSD 2-Clause (see `LICENSE`), which is compatible with Mentat's
  GPL 3.0 or later.

`YM7128B_emu.c` and `YM7128B_emu.h` are copied unchanged.
